readme:
# Vibrai — Releases

> **Downloads have moved to https://vibrai.com/download.** Releases here carry
> **only** the Claude Desktop extension (`Vibrai-X.Y.Z.mcpb`), because the MCP
> registry accepts packages hosted on GitHub/GitLab only. The installer, CLI
> tarballs, checksums and signed manifest are served from `downloads.vibrai.com`.
> This repository remains Vibrai's public issue tracker.

Signed download bundles for **Vibrai**, the AI music-production tool for Ableton Live.

- **Docs & install guide:** https://docs.vibrai.com
- **Home / buy:** https://vibrai.com
- **Download:** https://vibrai.com/download
- **Claude Desktop extension (MCP registry host):** https://github.com/cssllcio/vibrai-releases/releases

This repository hosts only the **release binaries** (the source tree is private).
Each release attaches signed macOS (`.pkg`), Claude Desktop
(`.mcpb`), and raw CLI bundles, plus `SHA256SUMS` for verification.

## Report a problem

Open an [issue](https://github.com/cssllcio/vibrai-releases/issues) — bug reports
and feature requests are welcome here even though the source is closed.
